title: Warm Sweet Canadian Almond Casserole
description: A sweet and comforting Canadian dish featuring almonds and a flambe touch, made FODMAP-friendly for all to enjoy. This shaggy casserole is perfect for a cold winter evening.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large mixing bowl, whisk together the eggs, brown sugar, maple syrup, and vanilla extract.
Add the sliced almonds to the bowl and stir until they are evenly coated with the egg mixture.
Pour the melted butter over the almond mixture and stir until it is well combined.
Pour the mixture into a 9x13 inch baking dish and smooth the top.
Bake the casserole for 25 minutes, or until it is lightly golden brown.
While the casserole is baking, heat the rum in a small saucepan over low heat.
Once the casserole is done baking, remove it from the oven and carefully pour the heated rum over the top.
Use a match or lighter to flambe the rum, being careful not to burn yourself.
Let the casserole cool for a few minutes before serving.
Serve the casserole warm, topped with additional sliced almonds if desired.
